story.title:
From Ceremony
to Community
story.p1: Fu Fut Coffee began with a simple belief: that the warmth of an Ethiopian coffee ceremony belongs everywhere. We pair heritage brewing methods with a modern café experience.
story.p2: Every bean is ethically sourced from Yirgacheffe, Sidamo, and Guji regions. Every dish honors traditional flavors while welcoming contemporary palates.

cards.name: Yirgacheffe Pour-Over
cards.flavor: Jasmine, bergamot, lemon zest — bright and tea-like
cards.desc: A bright, floral brew with notes of jasmine, citrus, and bergamot. Our light roast preserves the delicate complexity of this world-famous region.

cards.name: Sidamo Espresso
cards.flavor: Dark chocolate, ripe plum, wine-like acidity — bold and balanced
cards.desc: Rich, bold espresso with deep dark chocolate and plum undertones. Sourced from the fertile volcanic highlands of Sidamo.

cards.name: Guji Natural
cards.flavor: Blueberry, wine, honey — adventurous and complex
cards.desc: Natural process beans from the Guji highlands bursting with blueberry, wine, and honey character. An adventurous cup for the curious palate.

ceremony.title: The Coffee Ceremony
ceremony.desc: A centuries-old tradition of roasting, grinding, and brewing — shared with warmth and intention.

steps.title: Roasting
steps.text: Green beans are roasted over an open flame, filling the room with rich, aromatic smoke.

steps.title: Grinding
steps.text: The roasted beans are ground by hand using a traditional mortar and pestle.

steps.title: Brewing
steps.text: Coffee is brewed in a jebena — a clay pot — and served in three rounds: Abol, Tona, and Baraka.

gallerySection.title: Our Gallery
gallerySection.desc: Explore the warmth, aroma, and artistry of Fu Fut Coffee through our lens.
